meta.title: Olympus Squad
meta.description: A leader-and-specialists squad on top of Agent Teams: the Lead routes work to the Olympus roles (Apollo/analyst, Prometheus/PM, Themis/PO, Ariadne/UX, Athena/architect, Hephaestus/dev, Argus/test) and tracks it on the shared task board. In a new session pick the preset "Olympus Squad · 调度" and turn on "Use Agent Teams".
